title: Concept: Cloudflare R2 bucket listing in a response
description: An object listing served from the R2 S3 endpoint in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: R2 keys describe the object layout of the application, and a public listing exposes uploads, exports and backups to anyone who knows the endpoint.
applicability: Deployments that render an object listing served from the R2 S3 endpoint into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: R2 keys describe the object layout of the application, and a public listing exposes uploads, exports and backups to anyone who knows the endpoint.
